body:
GREG, 2026-11-07 about 06:35Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #539, message b47f128d), URGENT, verbatim: „NIE, PO CHUJ MAMY JAKIES REGULY KTORE BLOKUJA ZALICZENIE TESTU!!! WTF!” He compared it to gated control. Asistant's scope: don't narrow it to foreground/background, and don't ask for another decision about removing an artificial condition. Review the credit path and remove non-agreed rules that block credit for a test that was actually run. Apply the agreed rule: credit = the host-observed result plus source_id before == after (memory rules-greg-eo-credit-source-id-equality-2026-11-06). Check whether the already-run Questly Linux 1820/0 can be credited from existing data without a rerun. Report facts and the owner.
Trigger: TermAl's native observer withheld credit for Questly Linux (foreground, success, flutter.json 1820/0/0, S0 == after) only because Claude Code cut the 1.5 MB console output (output_cut → interrupted=true, nativeEligible=false). An earlier draft also blocked background runs.
RULE FOR EVERY AGENT: no credit-blocking condition beyond the agreed host-observed outcome and source_id equality without Greg's word. When a run was observed and its result artifact plus source_id equality hold, it earns credit.
